claim: For the first oblique two-kink bubble threshold in the extreme-ferromagnetic three-state Potts chain, let \(v=h_2/g>0\), let \(a_1\) be the first threshold satisfying \(F(0,a_1)=0\), set \(\alpha_*=4/(3a_1)\) and \(G(\alpha)=J_{1-\alpha}(\alpha)+4J_{-\alpha}(\alpha)\), and define \(c_1\) by \(p_1(v)=ic_1(v-a_1)+O((v-a_1)^2)\). Then \(c_1=-\frac{3\alpha_*^2}{4}\frac{G'(\alpha_*)}{J_{1-\alpha_*}(\alpha_*)}=8.696131059428713\ldots\), and the leading two-kink energy satisfies \(E_{\min}(g)-E_1(v,g)=K g(v-a_1)^2+O(g|v-a_1|^3)\), where \(K=\frac23c_1^2=50.41513026850717\ldots\).

integrity.proof_basis: Implicit differentiation of the Jost root and Taylor expansion of the stated two-kink dispersion relation.

scientific_limitations: Applies to the leading two-kink effective spectrum near the first positive-oblique bubble threshold.
The decimal values are high-precision numerical evaluations, not rigorous interval enclosures.
No nonperturbative conclusion for the full chain at arbitrary field strength is claimed.
title: Exact threshold curvature for the first oblique Potts bubble
